evidence.title: README (segment 5)
evidence.excerpt: By default, the command runs in interactive mode with prompts. You can skip these prompts by providing feature flags as CLI arguments. To see all available feature flags and options:

evidence.title: README (segment 6)
evidence.excerpt: This will show you various feature flags (like `--typescript`, `--router`) and options (like `--bare` for creating a project with minimal boilerplate).

evidence.title: README (segment 7)
evidence.excerpt: **PowerShell users:** You'll need to quote the double dashes: `npm create vue@latest '--' --help`

evidence.title: README (segment 8)
evidence.excerpt: - Vite-Powered: Vue CLI is based on webpack, while `create-vue` is based on [Vite](https://vite.dev/). Vite supports most of the configured conventions found in Vue CLI projects out of the box, and provides a significantly better development experience due to its extremely fast startup and hot-module replacement speed. Learn more about why we recommend Vite over webpack [here](https://vite.dev/guide/why.html).
